To summarize, the key findings of our research, stated in one sentence that includes all relevant information, are that
• The structure of memory retrieval is similar to information retrieval on the web.

1) the same computational problems arise in human memory and information search, and that the same methods are used to solve these problems; 2) the same computational models of human memory can also be used to model information search; 3) this leads to a better understanding of both systems; 4) it also leads to a better way to search for information, and to a better understanding about how search engines should be designed.
In summary, our research is concerned with
the relationship between the structure of the world and the structure of cognition, and with the computational problems that must be solved to make sense of the world.
the relationship between the human mind and computational systems.
the relationship between rational analysis and human cognition.

the evidence for the existence of a link between the human mind and the environment is very strong and that the evidence for a link between the mind and the brain is also strong, but less conclusive.
